title: Advanced: storage path mappings
noUploadOrMount: Doesn’t upload files or mount storage
switchDoesNotClear: Changing the execution environment keeps this draft
guidance: Match folders on the WaveDL server to folders in your Python environment.
guidanceDetails: Server folders are on the machine running WaveDL. Execution folders are in the selected Python environment. Mappings only change path text: they don’t upload files, mount storage, follow symbolic links or check access. Set up storage and your cluster’s access rules outside this form.
interpreterDetails: The Python interpreter path belongs to the execution environment, not the WaveDL server. Only add mappings you’ve already set up. This editor won’t change dataset paths or other paths in your draft.
local: Local execution doesn’t support storage mappings.
empty: No mappings set. Server paths will be used as usual.
limit: Up to 32 mappings, with 8192 characters per folder path.
rootError: Enter a valid full folder path without “..” folder steps or control characters (8192 characters maximum).
rowError: Server and execution folders must use the same path format, such as Windows or POSIX.
mapError: Use up to 32 mappings. Each server folder can appear only once.
